load_opts_from_json: load configuration options from a JSON file and validate them against NamedTuple type definitions
parse_opts_from_command_line: parse command-line arguments into a NamedTuple with optional subcommand support for CLI tools
load_opts_from_json_or_command_line: load options from a JSON file via --opts-path or fall back to command-line parsing
add_opts_to_parser: add NamedTuple fields as argparse arguments to an ArgumentParser with type conversion and defaults
print_opts: print all configuration options and their values to the logger for debugging purposes
